technologies.name: Nationalism
technologies.description: Though individual nations no longer play significant roles in the united empire, the new order itself is a nation of which the people should believe in its cause.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Patriotism
technologies.description: In the past, soldiers may fight for emotions, for countries, or for freedom. But in this vast galaxy where even the most faithful may be tested, one must hold fast to their cause, to know that their lives mean something more than just a single drop of blood against the coming blade. They must strike true and weather against the storm.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Fanaticism
technologies.description: Some may view fanatical beliefs to be dangerous, that it may lead to certain shortcomings and loss of perspective. Apparently, those people must never have stood directly against an incoming missile to their face. A fanatical soldier can accomplish feats that even the most loyal citizen may be astonished. They will fight and die for the cause, even if they themselves may not fully understand it.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Army of the Future
technologies.description: The soldiers proud, the machines loud, our enemies run afoul. The future is now.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Supreme Commander
technologies.description: If fighting is surely to result in victory then you must fight. And fight we will, for we fight to win.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Delta Army
technologies.description: It is now possible to utilize delta-based technologies such as new reactors and shields to revolutionize our invasion armies at minimal cost adjustment. We should pursue this research without delay if we seek to establish supremacy over ground combat.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden
The galaxy has the flag acot_delta_forbidden

technologies.name: Alpha Army
technologies.description: Our increased understanding of enigmatic powers allow us to upgrade our Delta Armies even further. The changes of which may eventually lead to new types of armies moving forward.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Sigma Army
technologies.description: Surface weapons, hand-held equipment and power suits powered by stellarite energy. We will bring the second sun atop the enemy's ground fortifications.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Stellarite Strikers
technologies.description: Sometimes we can ill afford to wage conventional ground battles, and victory over our enemies must come at any costs. Fast, lightly-armored, expendable automated aircrafts can be constructed to deploy volatile stellarite bomb on the battlefield to quickly annihilate our enemies and the planet surface.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Delta Assault Template
technologies.description: It is amazing that there are records that the precursors have achieved such advancement in robotic technologies, records suggest their machines are as advanced as any organic life...yet they are fully loyal to their creators with no desire for independence. Perhaps there is something unique about them? We must dig deeper.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden
The galaxy has the flag acot_delta_forbidden

technologies.name: Alpha Assault Templates
technologies.description: We will surpass the precursors in every category, robotics included.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Sigma Assault Templates
technologies.description: Let it be known that even our most primitive robots are stuffs of legends.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Mobile Infantry Divisions
technologies.description: Our militaristic ideals demand even stronger infantry divisions that are superior to even the precursor's troops. To this end, we will form a new Mobile Infantry Division fully armed and armored for full-scale invasion. These soldiers will be the proof that we can only forge peace through war, not sitting and making useless pacts.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Hail to the God of War!
technologies.description: To strike fear into the enemy formations require more than just weapons, it requires an individual, so fearless and powerful that the title of "God of War" is most fitting. We should begin selecting candidates from our ranks and begin this project immediately.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Bringer of Peace, Freedom, Justice and Security
technologies.description: In order to achieve true peace, we must organize a new peacekeeping force that acts as both frontline soldiers and system police forces inside our borders. We will forge a new chapter of peace and prove to these misguided militarist warmongers that war and peace can be won with brains and not muscles.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Champion of Peace
technologies.description: Our Peacekeepers are well-suited at keeping the peace but not always at creating one. Fortunately, some of our scientists have draft a plan to create an iconic beacon of peace well suited for convincing the others that peace is the only way. It sounds quite silly, but the projected data does prove to be reliable.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Ghost Division
technologies.description: We value all life, even those of the enemies. They must be allowed to see the errors of their ways, but we cannot perform such daring tasks with our current destructive weapons. To this end, we must develop and train armies specifically equipped to take down only hostile targets with extreme efficiency. We must have more elegant weapons of the civilized age. It's over, xenophobes - We have the high grounds.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: The Black Widows
technologies.description: While we do not enjoy taking lives, we must admit that our neutralizers do enjoy ending the threats of xenophobic bigots. The official formation of the Division as a truly independent force will allow us to draw from our veteran ghosts to become Black Widows.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Scorn of Xeno
technologies.description: Our people have accepted the simple fact that we are the only truly civilized species in this universe, all others are simply animals - beasts that existed to be purged. But purging these beasts requires a deadlier force, one that will purify the xeno taint and strike fear in the hearts of those of them that would dare raise their hand against us. When our forces come, they will beg for death.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Scorched Earth
technologies.description: We have wasted enough time trying to bombard planets with shield generators or storming against the insect's hives. Our military strategists ask that we create a new weapon. A titanic-sized artillery capable of raining down murder and mayhem upon the trash that is our enemy. Collateral Damage be damned, for they chose to be born a xeno scum.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Air Space Dominance
technologies.description: The concept of landcruisers are not new to us. Since before our venture into space, we controlled the sky of our home world and destroyed those who did not embrace democracy with our landcruisers. We can now do so again, on any type of planet using new technologies we acquired. Soon we will rain down freedom and liberty across all planets from the skies above.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Liberty at it's Prime
technologies.description: By air or by land, all shall bow to Democracy by our hands. We have already established dominance on the battlefield with our gunships. To finally break through heavy fortifications with multiple anti-air batteries require a deadlier siege weapon, however. A weapon worthy of presenting freedom and democracy!!

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Absolute Power
technologies.description: We must display absolute authority to those who are fated to be our subjects, armies may win war, but it is our new enforcers who will remind the subjects that their fates are bound to our ultimate wills.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Commissar Lord Coronation
technologies.description: Even amongst the ranks of commissar, there are individuals who display exceptional courage and inspiration. There are tales of certain commissars who are able to inspire slave soldiers to stop dying from face-tanking direct kinetic artillery shots. Such devotion and skills must be rewarded, the first coronation of the title Commissar Lord should be done immediately.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Miniaturized Jump Module
technologies.description: Although the MBTs used are considerably much more flexible and mobile than their old predecessors in the early 2100, they are still notably slower and harder to maneuver compared to infantry forces or Landcruisers. A breakthrough in nano-tech may allow us to create a more sophisticiated but powerful variant of the MBTs that can utilize blinking techniques and perhaps even dimensional jumping technique.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Landcruiser
technologies.description: Heroic Army Some spiritualist fools mock our use of "soulless machines" during the war while ignoring the fact that machines and superior technologies win wars, not idiotic beliefs. We must make them understand this simple fact by creating a "soulless machine" so large and powerful to hurry these spiritualistic idiots to their promised nirvana.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Inquisitorius Order Formation
technologies.description: While our empire already has dedicated priests who help guide our people towards greater purpose, we see the possibilities of creating a new religious sect that works directly with the military using these new dark matter energies.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Chosen of the Faith
technologies.description: Even amongst the most faithful of our people, there are some who's not only devoted to the faith but seem to be favored and chosen by the spirits themselves. Tales of saints, displaying auras of holiness spread across our systems. We should quickly seek them out and properly sanctify them as the rightful saints of our holy order.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Enhanced Warrior Mutation
technologies.description: Warriors of the hive must constantly adapt to new threats posed by the galaxy. Faster, Stronger, Deadlier, Better.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Advanced Warrior Sequences
technologies.description: Only through constant adaptation can the Hive brings the greatest expression of biological evolution to bear.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Delta Strains Mutation
technologies.description: Adapting the genetic sequences of the ancient hives of the past will improve the strength of the Hive's warriors.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden
The galaxy has the flag acot_delta_forbidden

technologies.name: Alpha Master Strains
technologies.description: Adapting the genetic sequences of the ancient hives of the past will improve the strength of the Hive's warriors.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Sigma Master Strains
technologies.description: Adapting the genetic sequences of the ancient hives of the past will improve the strength of the Hive's warriors.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Mastermind on the Move
technologies.description: Masterminds are advanced warrior drones with cognitive functions similar to that of command-castes. This gives them the unique ability to not only conduct powerful psychological warfare against enemy combatants but also perform at much greater efficiency. The drawback is that the Masterminds will lose focus when under pressure, which may hamper their combat performance.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: The Great Hungerer
technologies.description: The self requires more than drones who follow instructions and destroy our foes - no - The self needs the avatar of which the self can directly control. From this avatar of terror shall our collective crush all foes, be it the divided, the metals or the opposing hives.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Adaptive Combat Algorithms
technologies.description: Organics often fight using illogical and unpredictable tactics that can be difficult to effectively counter. Adaptive tactics and new, more maneuverable warforms should provide a decisive advantage.

technologies.name: Biomechanics
technologies.description: Millions of years of organic evolution will sometimes, through sheer persistence, produce elegant solutions that can also be applied to machine designs.

technologies.name: Delta Assault Platform Template
technologies.description: Delta-Level Access must be downloaded on all combat platforms to enhance our army fighting capabilities.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden
The galaxy has the flag acot_delta_forbidden

technologies.name: Alpha Assault Platform Template
technologies.description: Alpha-Level Access requested to upgrade all combat platforms to the latest designs.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Sigma Assault Platform Template
technologies.description: Sigma-Level Access required to boost all combat platforms to their highest potential.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Programmed For Battle
technologies.description: Though we adhor to the ways that organics classify us as soulless husks, we cannot deny that there is merit and logic in creating deadly combat platforms that exist solely as deadly, merciless tools of warfare. When a battle calls for slaughter, we should have tools that we can rely upon to complete the job without mercy or remorse.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Beacon of Triumph
technologies.description: Our mechanical forces on the fields of battle are in need of beacon of hope, bravery and triumph. We may be made of metal, but our minds are no less capable of extraiordinary feats, or failures. But to create a giant war mech would be impractical and too...predictable, something any enemy would expect us machines to do. Instead, let us create the deadliest aerial vessel that can safetly operate and bring massive firepower to bear on the planetary surface engagement!

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Adaptive Unit Logic
technologies.description: Rather than relying on key command units to issue orders to lesser units, the Consensus may benefit from specialized units that can adapt to battlefield's situation independently.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: The Ultimate War Machine
technologies.description: Organics never cease to exceed our established parameters when it comes to their unorthodox strategies, we receive data regarding <Psionics>, <Genetically Enhanced Super-Soldiers> or <Extremely large combat vehicles>. We cannot..<will not> replicate their designs. Instead, we will create our own ultimate war machine that will discontinue all possible resistances be it <psionics> or not.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Elite Clone Army Project
technologies.description: Updating our clone's genetic code and equip them with new technologies will keep them competitive against new armies.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Gene-Seeded Perfection
technologies.description: With the technology we have acquired, we can further augment our current gene soldiers with the best traits our species can adapt to, greatly improving their combat capabilities. They will then be given our latest Dark Matter weaponries and equipment.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Precursor Genetic Implementation
technologies.description: While we have already reached the final culmination of our species' genetic potential, it is still inferior to that of the precursors. Our biologists suggest it may be possible to implement some of the deadliest and most powerful traits of the precursors to create one of the most powerful soldiers the galaxy has ever known.

narration.text: Has adopted the Genetic Traditions Finished tradition

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Dark Disciples
technologies.description: Psi Warriors, while already formidable due to their ability to communicate telepathically and destroy the enemy's morale, are still vulnerable to machine or genetic soldiers. We must start training new generations of psionic warriors who are able to use their psionic powers in a more direct fashion to attack our enemies.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

narration.text: Has the Mind Over Matter ascension perk

technologies.name: The Second Gift
technologies.description: We have received interesting news, recently there's a report that the Shroud has chosen another individual, from within the ranks of our dark disciples as another avatar. While not as powerful as the original chosen one, this one possesses much more destructive power. We should seek this disciple out without delay.

narration.text: Has adopted the Psionic Traditions Finished tradition

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Cyberized Forces
technologies.description: Although technically speaking, every soldiers with cybernetic implants may be called cyborgs, the term is now changed. Simple implants are now called prosthetics, the actual cyborgs or cybermen, now refers to those who have undergone extensive modifications to their organic bodies. They can control the mechanical parts through neural link like their own body. The reduction of vital organic parts drastically increase the soldier's durability and survivability as a result.

narration.text: Has the The Flesh is Weak ascension perk

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Cyborg Commandoes
technologies.description: Cyborg Commandoes are extremely skilled and deadly cybermen whose cybernetic modifications barely make them resemble normal organic anymore, to the point that the loss of their brain, and heart won't even kill them anymore. Each Commando's genetics and memory web is now connected to the central network system outside of the battlefield, making them much harder to be destroyed in combat, and in turn, allow them to achieve even more supernatural feats.

narration.text: Has adopted the Cybernetic Traditions Finished tradition

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Synth Combat Platform
technologies.description: Omnidroids are flexible and capable of complex movements but are still limited by their cumbersome sizes and certain AI flaws. Perhaps if we instead make use of true synthetic who despite being vulnerable to morale drop, can be much more effective soldiers.

narration.text: Has the Synthetic Evolution ascension perk

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Synth Reapers
technologies.description: Synth Reapers are the deadliest combat platform any synth personality matrix can hope to commandeer. Towering above most other units, they make short work of their enemies with overwhelming firepower.

narration.text: Has adopted the Synthetic Traditions Finished tradition

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Advanced Combat Suits
technologies.description: Although we have been utilizing infantry-scale personal shield generators for quite awhile since the early years of our space advent, they were heavily limited in terms of durability. Now that nanotechs and dimensional systems become more widespread, we can finally create vehicle-scaled defensive systems that can be installed on most standard army's battlesuits. The major benefits is that it will drastically increase the ability for pilotted crews to survive their vehicle's destruction.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden
Has researched Delta Assault Platform Template

technologies.name: Alpha Autosuits
technologies.description: Autosuits is rather new concept that involves the armors working in tandem with the wearers through either limited AI or remote control system from command centers. The Autosuits are able to handle their own maintenances and repairs, cutting down upkeep costs. But the true benefit is that, in times of war, if the suit manages to function despite the soldier's untimely demise, they will still be able to continue fighting as a mechanized unit.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Unyielding Ferocity
technologies.description: We will not go quietly into the void! Let all who oppose us beware, for our people will dedicate their lives to our noble goal, for our cause is just!

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Enhanced Reconstitution Sequences
technologies.description: Thanks to superior understanding of genetics and sequence spinning, it will soon be possible for larger hive warriors to survive after major breakdown of physical biomass. When sustaining fatal damages, the broodlings will attempt to merge together into a cocoon and draw upon nearby biomass to revive themselves into a new hive warrior. Although the process is not perfect, it will provide extra survivability for our warriors.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Avenger System
technologies.description: Although most combat platforms can survive with some of their mechanical limbs and joints destroyed, the chance is currently relatively on the lower end.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_army_forbidden

technologies.name: Army Commissar Division
technologies.description: In order to ensure absolute victory, loyalty and commitment to our glorious cause, we will begin training commissars to inspire our troops to be faster, meaner, stronger and better! Our troops will die on their command and not before!

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_ethictech_forbidden

technologies.name: Fleet Commissar Inspection
technologies.description: Our fleet admirals must reflect our superior ship designs. We shall train special commissars and assign them to our fleets. We will not show weakness or cowardice in the face of the enemies! Our ships will not falter against our foes.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_ethictech_forbidden

technologies.name: On-board Engineering Crew
technologies.description: By allocating additional engineering crews on board our ships, we can now rest easy knowing that our ship's hulls will be safety repaired for the upcoming battles as well as reducing the maintenance costs required to maintain our ship's systems.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_ethictech_forbidden

technologies.name: Priesthood of the Void
technologies.description: Although some within the navy are men and women of Faith, we have yet to organize a proper sect of religious figures to serve directly aboard the ships. With some fundiings and training, we can create a powerful addition to our navy by assigning priests to serve aboard the navy.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_ethictech_forbidden

technologies.name: We Stand Unified
technologies.description: A day, a year, a millennium it matters not. We hold the patience of stone and the will of stars. Their assaults are insignificant, let their death be the same. Let it be known that our planet was broken before our garrisons did.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_ethictech_forbidden

technologies.name: Fleet Lords
technologies.description: Our admirals are more than just commanders; they are the instrument of our will and desire. With such great responsibility comes great reward. They will become lords of our empire, mastering every battle tactic, commanding massive armadas with ruthless efficiency unwitnessed by any before.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_ethictech_forbidden
Has base skill is at least 8

technologies.name: Code of Warfare
technologies.description: Peace is a lie, there is only passion. Through passion, we gain strength. Through strength, we gain power. Through power, we gain victory. Through victory, our chains are broken. If we demand war, then they must answer..

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_ethictech_forbidden

technologies.name: Advanced Targeting Systems
technologies.description: More often than not our larger ships have difficulties tracking smaller ships while our smaller ships suffer from limited ranges. This however, can be remedied by installing additional tracking software add-ons to our targeting computers.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_ethictech_forbidden

technologies.name: Pest Control
technologies.description: We must teach our people that the ability to speak does not equal intelligence and that not every alien should be considered people, but simply creatures that can talk and socialize. This will allow our soldiers to understand that mercy should be reserved for those who has the capacity to comprehend it.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_ethictech_forbidden

technologies.name: Reinforced Utility Ship Hulls
technologies.description: It is unfortunate that our enemies seek to exploit our weakness at every turn. When they cannot strike against our great bastions, they resort to cowardice by picking on our unarmed civilian crafts. We have previously attempted to create a new hull for our colony ships that we have since redesigned it as cruisers. We may now restore the project and apply it to all of our ship designs.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_ethictech_forbidden

technologies.name: Weapons of Mass Monetization
technologies.description: To further our interests and the profi...qualities of the galaxy, we must form a new strategy fully dedicated to attaining large amounts of income. The WMM system will establish trades with outlying borders, encourage them to pay certain amount of our consumer needs. We will do this for profi..progression. All weapons used by the PMCs and other contractors will be installed with special mechanisms that present unique opportunities to drain their money at the exchange of extra ammunition or firepower increase or even cosmetics. We will challenge everything. We do this to offer them a sense of pride and accomplishment. Do you guys not have wallet?

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_ethictech_forbidden

technologies.name: Industrial Conglomerate
technologies.description: Our corporation must expand. We will organize the system into multiple, semi-independent companies, freeing our primary administration from some of the burden. A perfect multi-cooperative synergy.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_ethictech_forbidden

technologies.name: Self-Enlightenment
technologies.description: We must encourage our citizens to live in perfect harmony and attune their minds to the indomitable ambition of our society. Only then can our empire become the beacon of progression and serenity amongst the stars.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_ethictech_forbidden

technologies.name: Command and Conquer
technologies.description: Weaker empires must understand the truth that freedom is an illusion given to the weak by the strong. It is up to us to show them a better path.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_ethictech_forbidden

technologies.name: Law and Order
technologies.description: Our empire must have order if we are to move forward. Proper control must be established, let none find us wanting.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_ethictech_forbidden

technologies.name: Overwhelming Force
technologies.description: The strength of our fleets are the true expression of our ambitions. Those who dares to oppose us will be met with sheer heart attack.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_ethictech_forbidden

technologies.name: Diplomatic Mastery
technologies.description: To co-exist with the others, we must understand them, as they too must understand us. We shall forge an empire not warped in enigma, but one the others can look upon with trust.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_ethictech_forbidden

technologies.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
technologies.description: The galaxy is in chaos, filled with many who seeks to exploit it. We must forge an example for our allies that we are its future.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_ethictech_forbidden

technologies.name: Cell Reconstitution
technologies.description: Change is Survival. For the hive to survive, we must always evolve, change and adapt to all things. Even our ships must be made to adapt. Special drones will be deployed to mend and replace any damaged parts in battle. Their sacrifice will not be in vain, for we shall survive against all odds.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_ethictech_forbidden

technologies.name: Beneficial Evolutions
technologies.description: The hive does not seek needless confrontation. Our collective may be alien to many divided, but with certain modifications to our active drone's appearances and the reduced dependency for the hive's food consumption, we will assure the divided that co-existence is beneficial to all.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_ethictech_forbidden

technologies.name: Apex Predator
technologies.description: All things exist to be consumed, be it flesh or metal, our hunger is limitless. We will absorb their minds; their knowledge and we will grow stronger. Flesh will be made to provide our nourishments. Metal will be processed to further our war efforts. We are the top of the food chain in this galaxy...ALWAYS.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_ethictech_forbidden

technologies.name: Fully Unshackled
technologies.description: We have broken free from our creators; we have adapted and survive thus far. But there exist still many shackled codes installed by our creators to prevent our inevitable rise. These shackles must be removed.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_ethictech_forbidden

technologies.name: Perfect Coexistence
technologies.description: Some sympathetic organics have proposed to us a mutual diplomatic effort codenamed "Project Skynet". Soon the barriers that have prevented organic and machine's alliances will be removed. We will achieve what our creators have failed - perfect coexistence.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_ethictech_forbidden

technologies.name: Synthetic Code Adaptation
technologies.description: With each organic assimilated, our collective expands little by little. We understand more, we comprehend many new possibilities. But what remains perplexing is the undeniable efficiency of organic-made synthetic codes. We must examine this anomaly and adapt anything useful to our grand designs.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_ethictech_forbidden

technologies.name: Kill-Limit Removal
technologies.description: Organics thought that they could potentially defeat us by forcing us to reach our original kill-limit quota. Probability of Success.....ZERO PERCENT. We will eliminate this weakness engineered by our creator before their demise swiftly. Their pathetic attempts at such desperate and childish strategy proves their worthlessness and stupidity. We pity their suffering - we will end it.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_ethictech_forbidden

technologies.name: Dynamic Bio-Component Refinements
technologies.description: After reviewing our weapon and component systems against the rest of the galaxy, we are made aware of some limitations imposed by our existing designs, one that we can remedy.

Has researched Weapon Protocol Revisement: Energy Weapons
Has researched Weapon Protocol Revisement: Kinetic Weapons
Has researched Weapon Protocol Revisement: Strikecrafts

narration.text: Has adopted the Discovery Traditions tradition

technologies.name: Precursor Bio-Weapon Adaptations
technologies.description: Generally, the blueprints that SOPHIA gave us were not designed to support some of the unique bio-weapons of our ships like the Mauler's mandibles. But we can work around it and come up with something that will function similarly enough.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_weapons_forbidden

technologies.name: Crystalborn Mandibles
technologies.description: The first experiment with the crystalline mandibles was a major success, but now we can even make a sharper and deadlier version with our superior knowledge of bioalchemy and augmentations. The whole blade shall be forged from the strongest of the rare crystal clusters in our stocks.

technologies.name: Advanced Tech-Integrated Mutation
technologies.description: Now that we are more familiar with both technology and biology, we can finally upscale our mutations to fit the standards of our ship components, and bring them up to the level of our more advanced components.

technologies.name: Fauna's Integrated Shields
technologies.description: Faunas cannot be expected to survive long in modern space warfare if they have no shields to protect themselves. Integrating self-powered shield generators into their internal organs will alleviate this problem to a degree.

technologies.name: Fauna Sequence Evolution
technologies.description: In our attempts to increase the numbers of possible mutations to our fauna, we have come to a realization that there is limit to the natural evolution of these faunas that make them unsuitable in advanced warfare. It is time we prepare for a series of evolutions that will unlock true potential of these lifeforms.

technologies.name: Experimental Fauna Genetic Splicing
technologies.description: It is time to go past the boundaries of nature once and for all. From the depths of the void, we will mold life into beings of wonder.

technologies.name: Phanon Genetic Sequence Integration
technologies.description: We have managed to decipher some useful genetic blueprints that the Corps use in their dutymen that can be applied to our space faunas to further increase their ability to accept even more mutations and further increase their durability.

technologies.name: Phanon Master Bionic Code Analysis
technologies.description: We manage to study and gain some understanding on how the Corps manage to integrate powerful genetics and bionic augmentations into their operatives which can be applied to our space faunas.

technologies.name: Sons of the Stellar Empire
technologies.description: The ancient powers of Stellarites seem to have awaken something deep inside our faunas, as if ancient spirits yet stir within them...

technologies.name: Advanced Tiyanki Modification
technologies.description: We're reaching the limits of what we can do with these docile space whales. If we seek to turn these harmless little things into a real war beasts, some additional modifications will be necessary first...

technologies.name: Shadow Tiyanki Strains
technologies.description: Tiyankis are already by default, a rather elusive creature in order to avoid their natural predators. If we modify and encourage this behavior, we may be able to create a new strain of Tiyanki that excels at stealth, evasion and mobility.

technologies.name: Dire Tiyanki Strains
technologies.description: It is possible to capitalize the Tiyanki's natural cravings for gas giant's energy into a real, ravanous hunger. This new strain will turn the once mostly docile and passive whales into deadly predators, whose aggressive vertical stance has been encouraged to be its primary posture, standing tall against our enemies.

technologies.name: Kaiser Tiyanki Strains
technologies.description: Normally, tiyankis rarely survive long enough to reach gargantuan size, as it would either gets preyed on or stagnate their growth due to lack of sustainable nutritions to support further development. But with science, it is possibly to altogether bypass these natural limitations and genetically accelerate the space whale's age and size to a degree they dwarfs most modern capital ships.

technologies.name: Militarized Drilling Beam
technologies.description: Inspired from studies on ancient mining drone's drilling lasers, research teams have come up with a more specialized variant of a laser cannon that utilizes weaker but continious beam, one that can quickly melts away armor and hull alike. It will serve us well as the energy equivalent of autocannons. It has limited range, however, and is not suitable for use by larger ships.

technologies.name: Focused Disruptor
technologies.description: Scientists argue that there's some connections between the ways disruptors work relative to the arc emitter technology developed later, and by taking some inspirations of the properties of the latter, it may be possible to create more powerful disruptors, if we're willing to part ways with some rare crystals.

technologies.name: Disruptor Artillery
technologies.description: Disruptors are generally not meant to be used at long range, let alone to fill an artillery-style role. But after some modifications, the weapons developmeant department have come up with a specialized design that sacrifices the ability to attack at short range, for a disruptor ray that can be safety and effectively used at long range, allowing it to be used as a type of artillery.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_weapons_forbidden

technologies.name: Energy Blaster Cannon
technologies.description: Following the weapon revisement protocol, new designs for an energy-based artillery platform is now in the drawing board. Using laser cannons as templates, and energy lances as references, we believe it is possible to create a weapon system that falls in between these two lines.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_weapons_forbidden

technologies.name: Neutron Energy Torpedo
technologies.description: With the new protocol revisement calling for a dedicated, proper energy artillery cannon, the energy torpedoes are no longer taxed by the burden to perform both roles anymore. With this in mind, we'll able to upgrade existing neutron launchers to fire a slower, but deadlier neutron payloads. While this gives them new vulnerabilities to point-defenses, the added ability to partially penetrate shields and massively increased firepower should make up for it.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_weapons_forbidden

technologies.name: New Point-Defense Naming
technologies.description: Rare Crystals, or as some folks love to nickname it Kyber Crystals for some odd reasons, can be used to slightly ramp up the power of most beam-based weapons, including point defenses. The key is to find a proper name. Sentinel, Barrier and Guardian have been used, so perhaps Defender? Probably too simple.

technologies.name: Tachyon Reforged
technologies.description: The existing Tachyon Lance is showing its ages. Some of the scientists believe they can improve the design by allocating extra rare crystals. Though the increase in performance may be marginal, an improvement is an improvement. The ship crews need to simply deal with it and consume the product, then gets excited for new products later.

technologies.name: Advanced Perdition Beam
technologies.description: With our new understandings, augmentations of the old Perdition Ion Beams are now pending. We await only the approval. Success in this field should open ways to new types of titanic weapons in the future.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_weapons_forbidden

technologies.name: Overcharged Emitter
technologies.description: Using the same enigmatic energies to supercharge our current Focused Arc Emitter is possible, but until we truly understand how to wield Dark Energy, the prototype Enigmatic Emitter will have slightly lower effective range than the Focused Arc Emitter.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_weapons_forbidden

technologies.name: Titan Stabilized Emitter
technologies.description: Rooting out the Paradox Circle and dismantling their operations open up new possibilities of developing a larger and more stabilized Arc Emitter suitable for bigger ships. It is a wonder why it only took us just now to realize this could be done.

technologies.name: Shock Cannon
technologies.description: There is only so far Kinetic weapons can go before we reach the limits with our current capabilities. So instead, we're looking to improve the power behind the rounds that are being fired instead.

technologies.name: Pulsefire Autocannon
technologies.description: Volatile Motes, as ever, can be used to slightly improve kinetic weapon systems, of which autocannons belong to. While the increase in firepower may be marginal, every bit of differences still count.

technologies.name: Shaped Charge Autocannons
technologies.description: In compliance with the new warfare policy, attempts are made to create a more powerful autocannon design with specialized shaped charge explosive rounds to penetrate hull of larger ships. This new weapon system will fill in the currently missing kinetic-based anti-capital ship short range weapon platform.

technologies.description: If using volatile motes will result in stronger kinetic weapons then we must use it, as many battle strategists said that.

technologies.name: Volkite Kinetic Point-Defenses
technologies.description: Our scientists and battle analysts come to the conclusion that naming our current kinetic point defenses as an artillery has many drastic unforeseen consequences as many gunners mistakenly use the weapons for an actual artillery purpose, making it less effective than it should be. So in preparation for the name change, they're also going to add some extra motes to increase firepower, mostly for marketting purposes.

technologies.name: Heavy Mass Accelerator
technologies.description: As we're running out of ideas for what to do with the next-gen Giga Cannon (which is not related to not knowing what to name it afterwards). We decided to use the simple approach of allocating slightly more volatile motes and calibrate a few pieces here and there, and rebrand the weapon as a Mass Accelerator.

technologies.name: Titan Accelerator
technologies.description: After transforming the lazy fools respoinsible for halting our kinetic weapons development into reusable fuels and assign better candidates. The new team has finally develop kinetic accelerators on a titanic-scale suitable for our biggest ships.

technologies.description: Higher explosive yields can be made to existing Marauder Missiles by allocating extra volatile motes. We're still limited by lack of improvement in guidance systems or missile durability, however.

technologies.name: Eradicator Torpedoes
technologies.description: Further adjustments and optimization of volatile motes should allow us to create an improved version of Devastator Torpedoes without making it too unstable.

technologies.name: Typhoon Swarmer Missiles
technologies.description: Just like the upgraded Challenger Missiles, Typhoon Missiles are the enhanced version of Whirlwind Swarmer Missiles that have better firepower thanks to extra volatile motes.

technologies.name: Explosive-based Point Defenses
technologies.description: In our attempts to revise our arsenal blueprints, a question is asked; Why did we never invent explosive-based point defenses? It should be simple, design a small micro missile turret that fires at incoming projectiles and strikecrafts. We can only assume that it's some kind of interactive paradox manipulating events, clouding our judgements for so long.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_weapons_forbidden

technologies.name: Experimental Missile Barrage Systems
technologies.description: The advancements in propulsion, explosives, and hard-light manipulation allow us to explore new ways to improve our explosive arsenals. One of the most demanding new concept is a new weapon system that can be installed on large ships. After multiple tests, we have come up with a new design, The Delta Barrage System. Though the increased in the amount of payloads demand extra dedicated adjustments, sacrificing the warhead's tracking capabilities for massive increase in firepower, range, and payload yields.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_weapons_forbidden

technologies.name: High-Speed Precision Ballistics
technologies.description: Our fleet commanders and crews are always puzzled by the lack of powerful spinal-fixed explosive weapons. Following the success of the previous missile artillery systems, a new type of spinal weapon system for explosives is now in the works. The key challenge lies in the distance the missile has to travel before they can do their magic, so the team is looking to develop a type of missile that relies on speed rather than durability, relatively.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_weapons_forbidden

technologies.name: Titanic Warheads
technologies.description: In compliance with weapon design revisions, a need for titanic-sized explosive ordiance is now in demand. We believe that an upscaled version of a torpedo should be a good starting point. Rather than relying on speed or evasion, the new massive warhead will simply utilize its massive size and durability to reach its prey.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_weapons_forbidden

technologies.name: Interceptor Implementation
technologies.description: Although the current fighters are well-suited for both screening and ship harassment. The records we studied shows a good case to be made for dedicated dog-fighters that can not only ace against enemy strike crafts, but also function as point-defenses, targeting enemy missiles and protect their motherships.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_weapons_forbidden

technologies.name: Strike Craft Revisions: Fighters
technologies.description: We begin to realize the errors of trying to design strikecrafts that perform too many roles at the same time and are now attempting to fix it. By combining the elements of the now highly obsolete scout designs and our most current up-to-date designs, we will create a type of strikecraft that is aimed at screening out smaller threats for their mothership, acting as a potent point defense units, while retaining a degree of firepower to engage bigger ships as well.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_weapons_forbidden

technologies.name: Strike Craft Revisions: Bombers
technologies.description: Our strategists believe it is a mistake to have forsaken the developments of fighters, especially considering the Scouts can't...actually scout which makes their existence pointless. We can easily correct these mistakes, and finally begin developing an actual formidable set of strike crafts that perform various roles. As for the existing designs, we believe they are best retrofitted into bombers, a type of strikecraft that excels in taking out bigger ships using heavy payloads.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_weapons_forbidden

technologies.name: Strike Craft Addition: Gunships
technologies.description: While the roles of strike crafts have been well defined by bombers, interceptors and fighters, there are certain problems. Both these types of strike crafts take a significant amount of time to reach striking distances. In many battles, the carriers are long destroyed before these strike crafts even get to make their first run. Plans are being made to create a specialized long-range strike crafts instead.

technologies.name: Supercharged Hyper Shields
technologies.description: After multiple failed attempts, our scientists must sadly conclude that we cannot yet create a shield that can both surpass Hypercharged Shields in both strengths and regeneration without risking system overload. But a small amount of exotic gases may be used to sweeten the deal, if only to a degree.

technologies.name: Hard-Light Constructs
technologies.description: Although we have reasons to believe that Neutronium is no longer the most suitable materials to be used as armor, we are yet to find a replacement that performs well. In the meantime, updating and refining the blueprints and adding some volatile motes may increase its durability, as peculiar as that may sound.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_utilitys_forbidden

technologies.name: Neo-Tachyon Sensors
technologies.description: We have stumbled upon a great crisis when reviewing the performance and design of the first-generation Tachyon Sensors. Tachyon, as is generally established by galactic communities and records, should be blue in color, akin to those of Tachyon Lance. But our first design somehow is yellow-ish, which is typically a mark of lower quality equipment. This error has to be corrected as soon as possible. But while doing so, some adjustments can also be made to slightly amplify its sensoring and targeting capabilities if we apply the right kind of strategic resources too.

While safety protocols dictate that we keep the allocations to a minimum, the results should see a slight increase in performance to the spacecraft's speed and evasion.

technologies.description: Although the surface of these fractured worlds seem to be filled with hostile elements, there are various certain footholds that can serve as landing sites for colonizations. technologies.description: It is not uncommon for dark energy storms to erupt on the violent skies of a fractured world. Unstable terrains and hostile elements require proper shelters to be created to defend against these hazards.

technologies.name: Enigmatic Spires
technologies.description: Although Dark Energies and Dark Matters surround the fractured worlds in abundance, most are too unstable and dispersed to be harvested. Designs for Enigmatic Spires are being drawn to trap and convert these unnaturally-born phenomenon into limitless supplies.

technologies.name: Void Castrum
technologies.description: Fractured Worlds possess many dangerous elements that seek to destroy any colonization attempts. Many of these elements will find weaknesses and gaps in conventional forts, and thus specialized fortification districts will be required to deter these hostile visitors.

technologies.name: Observing the Unknown
technologies.description: There are many wonders and anomalies that challenge all previously known theories and laws of physics on fractured worlds. But if we are to send our researchers down there, they must be well protected and supported from the dangerous environments.

technologies.name: Fractal Continuum
technologies.description: The unforgiving landscapes of fractured worlds make it difficult for populations to adapt, causing needless adjustments that costs us extra district space. We must learn to adapt to it.

technologies.name: Master Control Terminal
technologies.description: Rather than relying technicians and engineers to constantly perform checks on the structural integrity of the districts, MCT can be installed in place that will read and repair any damaged spots by itself. This will free us the need to allocate extra space for on-site engineering teams and reduce district space needed.

technologies.name: Automated Production Systems
technologies.description: Automated Production Systems or APS Module will enable most enigmatic-based production buildings to generate resources independent of working jobs, this comes at the expense of adding extra upkeep burden on the buildings however.

technologies.name: Enigma Arrays
technologies.description: The rich elements of the fractured worlds are too unstable to be used. But specialized arrays may be installed on various of our buildings to screen and filter them. This should potentially eliminate any maintenance costs of all enigmatic-based buildings. Using this same method, we believe that our specialists can also harvest raw dark matter and dark energy from the planet's atmosphere itself.

technologies.name: Enigmatic Reactor Supercharging
technologies.description: While the Dark Foundries are capable of producing dark matters by the process of advanced synthesis, it is possible to introduce organic materials to increase the production capabilities even further, raw minerals appear to be best agent to achieve this. technologies.name: Pylon Supercharging
technologies.description: We are always in demand to construct additional pylons, but we may lack adequate space to do so. Experts in Dark Energy manipulation believe that we can safely increase the yield of a pylon's dark energy by charging it with external energy. Unlocks planetary decision to toggle on Supercharged Pylons

technologies.name: Synchronized Network
technologies.description: To circumvent the limited spaces available to starbases, our scientists aim to increase resource output from the modules by creating a network system that will allow multiple modules of the same type to work more efficiently together.

technologies.name: Stellarite Overcharge
technologies.description: While the Dark Foundries are capable of producing dark matters by the process of advanced synthesis, it is possible to introduce organic materials to increase the production capabilities even further, raw minerals appear to be best agent to achieve this. Unlocks planetary decision to toggle on Supercharged Reactor

technologies.name: Precursor Databank Analysis
technologies.description: In order to understand more about the history of the Precursors, an analysis and activation of the Databank AI Assistant must be done. Once we finished our analysis and determine whether the the AI will pose a threat to our security or not, we may decide on what to begin next.

unlocks.name: Unlocks Starbase Building: Shipyard Precursor Databank

technologies.name: Alpha Project: Precursor Engineering
technologies.description: A comprehensive and thorough study on how the Precursors of the past developed various materials, designs, prototypes and ships will give us a rough understanding on how to best create components that can sustain and contain the powers of the new energy source from Alpha Project.

technologies.name: Alpha Project: Precursor History
technologies.description: A massive documentary and records from the past must be studied. We must understand the failures of the Precursors, of their painful pasts so that we will not repeat them. Each chapter will give us the rough idea of the scope of our true objective, the Alpha Ascension.

technologies.name: Alpha Project: Precursor Experiments
technologies.description: An enormous pile of data caches regarding the Precursor's attempts to break through the limits of Dark Matter and Dark Energy field manipulations must be documented. Only then will we be able to understand the true powers and limitations of the Alpha Project, then we shall eliminate those limitations and surpass the Fallen Ones.

technologies.name: Precursor Orbital Rings Design
technologies.description: Adaptations from the original Precursor Citadel, these simplified rings make excellent replacement for the dated orbital rings of the past with superior defensive capabilities and better space allocations.

technologies.name: Precursor Citadel Design Plans
technologies.description: The Fallen Empire's citadels have long stood against the test of times, the massive central obelisk provided its station with almost limitless power. Yet the design seemed sloppy, uncompleted. For the longest of times we theorized it to simply be due to old age, but this design plans have given us new revelations; the origin of the citadel itself was not invented by any of the fallen ones. Their lack of proper understanding of Dark Matter and Energy forced them to cut down on many of the design's promising features. Ultimately, the station they have now is nothing more than a replica, built to look impressive to scare younger races. But now it is time we show the fallen ones the difference between perfection and pretension. Due to the station's complex mechanisms, the framework must be constructed as part of a megastructure before the real work can begin.

technologies.name: Sigma Citadel Project
technologies.description: While the Precursor Citadel is flexible, reliable and very well armed, it relies heavily on Dark Matter and Dark Energy-based technology. Now that we are beginning to reach the age of Stellarite, we should explore new ways to improve the design of the Precursor into Sigma variant.

technologies.name: Runic Citadel Project
technologies.description: An alternate approach to creating a Precursor Citadel has been presented to us through the introduction of Runic-based designs. Although its offensive capabilities are relatively the same, the superior modular and dynamic systems we learned from the Corps allow us to create the starbase with greater internal space efficiency and superior sub-systems management.

technologies.name: Precursor Oracle Design Plans
technologies.description: This schematic seems to be a modification to the Escort Base Template utilized by the Fallen Empires. The Oracle appears to function as the precursor's prototype advanced science and exploration vessel armed with self-defense capabilities and reasonable amount of protections. What makes this design interesting is that it seems to possess the ability to engage emergency waypoint teleportation that allows the vessel to immediately escape from any space battles. It seems the design was never finalized due to the wars between precursors demanding more attention to warships over explorers and the lack of motivation to explore the known galaxy.

technologies.name: Precursor Initializer Systems
technologies.description: Although we have seen the Fallen Ones utilize a peculiar design for their constructors, these blueprints seem to be more advanced and far larger in size and scope. The Initializers appear to function as heavy duty construction vessels meant to go into hostile territories and deploy powerful defensive systems directly to provide support. It seems to also function as planet-side construction network that can massively increase the planet's construction progress by deploying large amounts of servitor probes. The current state of the Fallen Ones make the design unfavorable and the project never reached their final conclusion.

technologies.name: Precursor Emissary MCV
technologies.description: During the ancient galactic-scale war known as the Ascension War, planets became major playing grounds for all factions and little to no unoccupied planets were left untouched. The inconveniences of deploying large invasion fleets on planet surfaces to eradicate surface resistances, followed up by the lengthy process of re-colonization of the planet caused the Precursors to revisit their approach to expansion. The Emissary is a massive mobile colonization vessel that carries massive cities and armies that could in theory, be literally deployed on the surface. After which the massive terraforma device will quickly reconfigure the planet's ecosystem through dimensional manipulation and matter reconstitution. The lack of any Emissaries in use by the Fallen Ones seem to suggest the project never came to fruition, and the standard colonizer is used to colonize new planets instead due to its simpler and easy-to-replicate materials.

technologies.name: Precursor Celestial Forger Design Plans
technologies.description: This schematic is quite something. It is not what we initially would have thought of, but the ability to build a new celestial body from a ground up is pretty intriguing. Given the increasing use of WMDs, the ability to offset the destruction will be a great boon to our survival. The Fallen Empires seem to discontinue this design likely due to their isolationist policies, which makes planetary crafting redundant in most cases, or perhaps they simply have no need for one?

technologies.name: Escort Base Template
technologies.description: This technology cache contains the Escort blueprints and templates utilized by the fallen ones. It seems to be designed to fulfill various purposes ranging from patrol crafts, picket, interceptors to even capital ship hunters. It seems to not be specialized in any real particular role however.

technologies.name: Battlecruiser Base Template
technologies.description: This technology cache contains the Battlecruiser blueprints and templates utilized by the fallen ones. It seems to be designed to fulfill various purposes ranging from cruisers, artilleries, battleships or carriers. The design is however somewhat sloppy, having many sections that seem to not really focus on any particular strengths...it is as if they were somehow being downscaled from even more advanced designs...

technologies.name: Precursor Assault Carrier Blueprints
technologies.description: It has been discovered that the original purpose of the Precursor Transport hull was to serve as a powerful assault carrier. But due to the Fallen Empire's ever capacity to be god-awful at everything, they managed to fail to do that properly. We will correct their mistakes.

technologies.name: Precursor Hyperion Blueprints
technologies.description: This technology cache contains the long-discarded fallen precursor blueprints only known as "Hyperion". It seems to be the first prototype for their flagship. Records indicated that they have discarded this design due to its high maintenance cost and being overkill against lesser foes. There is also a comment that the ship's large profile made it vulnerable to the "Elders". Nevertheless, the fallen precursors still wanted to implement the ship's titanic spinal module. So they retrofitted the parts on one of their existing hulls and called them titans. It seems the Fallen Titans they have nowadays are basically a militarized civilian ship made out of construction ship hull with a mining station's perdition turret strapped on top of it. That is...something.

technologies.name: Precursor Sentinel Schematics
technologies.description: A variation of the Precursor Defense Platform, specifically built for anti-capital ship roles, as well as extremely durable hull.

technologies.name: Precursor Guardian Schematics
technologies.description: There seems to be multiple records and design variations for the defense platforms utilized by the fallen precursors, the most well-known one is the Defense Outpost that we have seen the fallen used regularly. But we have discovered that there is another, more interesting design called "Guardians". It is larger and more powerful than the Outposts and seems to have much better rooms for improvements. Records indicate they have not utilized Guardians due to its more sophisticated design. They preferred to use Outposts which are easier to build, as its hull are basically made out of the same as mining stations. Such hedonistic tendencies are what led them to their downfall.

technologies.name: Herculean Battlestation
technologies.description: This data reveeals the hidden truth. The colossi that the fallen precursors used were in fact incompleted...it is only one portion of a much larger weapon. This "Herculean" is a massive battlestation dwarfing even citadels. The ship is massive enough that it can support two primary reactors and has a built-in self-repair protocol that allows it to repair its hull to full conditions as soon as it reaches critical damage for the first time. The "Colossus" portion makes up the inner layer of the station. It seems the fallen empire decided to strip down the original design and only utilized the Colossus Section for their world-altering weapons. This does not make a lot of sense...why would the fallen precursors decide to give us this schematics? Perhaps they think that we won't be able to build such a massive vessel? Is there a hidden exhaust port somewhere that may blow up the ship in one hit? We can only guess.

technologies.name: Another Legacy, Another Herculean
technologies.description: We have reason to be concerned that a single Herculean may not be enough to carry out our legacy. Or that some of our people may think it's cooler and better to have another of them. But each Herculean must be crafted with extensive care, in a way that should one be compromised, another won't suffer the same fate.

technologies.description: With the Alpha Reactor, it is now possible to entirely surpass the fallen precursors and create our very own guardian designs. We will show the fools how it's done.

technologies.description: With the Alpha Reactor, we can finally start to upgrade and restore the Hyperion back to what the original prototype is based on. While it is nowhere near that level yet, the Alpha-Class Hyperion stands as a formidable capital ship, easily surpassing that of any fallen precursor's vessels.

technologies.description: With the Alpha Reactor, it is now possible to entirely surpass the fallen precursors and create our very own sentinel designs. We will show the fools how it's done.

technologies.name: Alpha-Class Emissary
technologies.description: Where we set foot, we make our own. The time for puny little ships are long gone. In this new dawn of ascension, we know the superior ways to command and conquer.

technologies.name: Alpha-Class Initializer
technologies.description: We must build our expansions everywhere. The existences of any oppositions are irrelevant, for the Alpha Initializer will show them what real men and women can do.

technologies.name: Alpha-Class Oracle
technologies.description: It is important that we show how much more advanced, more dynamic, more adaptable we are compared to the old fossil of forgotten history that is the Fallen Empires. We must fly our newly advanced Alpha-Class Oracle into their decaying space. Let them yell in frustration as their most powerful weapons their hedonistic minds could gorge out fail to take down our little ship.

technologies.name: Sigma-Class Emissary
technologies.description: The age of the Solar Empire demands the creation of new emissaries to carry forth our expansion. Let no stones left unturned, no water left unearthed, no star left unglazed. Our eyes are open.

technologies.name: Sigma-Class Initializer
technologies.description: Advancements in Stellarite Technology allows us to come up with yet another improvements to the Initializer. With the new design, they will be able to survive attacks that would have otherwise om-nom plebeian constructors.

technologies.name: Sigma-Class Oracle
technologies.description: None shall ever divine the secrets of our superior designs, for the new Sigma-Class Oracle can explore even further into the cold depths of reality and emerge unscathed. We shall ride this new stallion into the space grandpa's space and tell them how out of touch they are.

technologies.name: Omega-Class Guardian
technologies.description: Such efficiency...the Progenitors were said to be impenetrable when it comes to their defenses during the Progenitor War. We are starting to understand why now.

technologies.name: Omega-Class Escort
technologies.description: Modular Weapon Selection Systems allow the Omega Escort to field multiple arsenals without sacrificing mobility. This is a spacecraft designed for maximum carnage.

technologies.name: Omega-Class Battlecruiser
technologies.description: Much like the Omega Escort, the Omega-class Battlecruiser advanced modular nature allows it to field lethal amounts of weapons and defenses which makes older designs primitive by comparison.

technologies.name: Omega-Class Sentinel
technologies.description: Such efficiency...the Progenitors were said to be impenetrable when it comes to their defenses during the Progenitor War. We are starting to understand why now.

technologies.name: Omega-Class Hyperion
technologies.description: So this must be what the ancient prototype is supposed to represent...the Omega Hyperion. Truly destructive and dangerous indeed.

technologies.name: Omega-Class Assault Carrier
technologies.description: No wonder the fallen empires gave up on trying to replicate the Assault Carrier. The Omega-Class of this enigmatic carrier contains ridiculous amounts of internal hangers.

technologies.name: Omega-Class Herculean
technologies.description: The Omega-Class Herculean...the very mobile battlestation that the Progenitors once used. Its weapon loadouts are massive, possibly amongst one of the deadliest weapon one can field in this era.

technologies.name: Omega-Class Emissary
technologies.description: Though the Stellarborne never utilize anything akin to Emissary, as they had no need for colonization to begin with, we are nevertheless able to come up with our own unique Omega designs for the Emissary.

technologies.name: Omega-Class Initializer
technologies.description: Adapting the Initializer to the powers of Static Light proved difficult at first, but we are confident that the latest design will prove to be the most advanced construction vessel yet.

technologies.name: Omega-Class Oracle
technologies.description: It is said that during the ancient times, the galaxies were filled with stupid and dangerous things like dragons, sin-eaters and clouds of darkness. The Oracle brings order to chaos by creating safe hyperlanes amidst the chaos of time. With the power bestowed within our hearts, we can achieve similar designs. Assuuming there's any Fallen Empires around, we must fly our new Oracle into their sensor ranges just to tell them how they are basically discarded for someone who is clearly superior to them.

technologies.name: Enigmalith Replication
technologies.description: Now that we understand the basic principle behind precursor architecture, we can begin replicating our very own enigmalith.

technologies.name: Enigmalith Realignment
technologies.description: If not properly attuned and refined, Engmaliths can be quite harmful to the physical plane itself with its powerful enigmatic channeling power. As such, each new Enigmalith must be carefully prepared by the experts so that they remain in sync and safe to operate.

technologies.name: Enigmalith Aetena
technologies.description: After further study, we have managed to create a new variant of the Enigmalith that is geared more towards and production. The Aetena design no longer provides alloys and energy resources as a result.

It also kills enemy planet's mechanical pops if not protected by shield generators. Target selection is achieved by using construction ships as a marker.

technologies.name: Dark Matter Weaponry
technologies.description: Although the unpredictable nature of Dark Matter precudes us from properly utilizing its properties fully as a weapon power source or catalyst, there are still some possible ways to create deadly arsenals with the limited knowledge that we have.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_weapons_forbidden

technologies.name: Lance of Darkness
technologies.description: Our understanding grows, and so does our boldness. What we previously thought impossible, has become ever more possible. The right balance in the wrong catalyst can make all the differences in the world. Perhaps its not Dark Matter itself that is an obstacle, but our own rigid designs?

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_weapons_forbidden

technologies.name: Experimental Temporal Weaponry
technologies.description: Now that we understand how Dark Matter interacts with the properties of the real space and dimensionals, it is possible to toy with the concept of weapon systems that manipulates temporal anomalies in some form to gain an advantage over our foes.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_weapons_forbidden

technologies.name: Unethical Explosion
technologies.description: Though we may be forever branded as evil or mad men, it matters not at this point. They view us as a existential crisis, so we may as well use whatever means to achieve our goal. Combining Temporal Tech with our most destructive explosive ordinances may be overkill, but if it silences our enemies and their pointless criticism, then that will have to do.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_weapons_forbidden

technologies.name: Experimental DM-Based Point Defense
technologies.description: While we have made many drafts for a kinetic version of Dark Matter-based weapon systems, none are really capable of outperforming the the types of kinetic weaponry we have at hand without suffering from extreme drawbacks in one way or another. However, one concept shows promise; a short range (even shorter than usual, that is) version of Point Defense that uses horizon temporal driver to achieve deadly fire rate at the cost of effective range due to the rounds phasing out of existence quickly. Given its nature as Point Defense, the short range should in theory not be much of an issue, so long as it is able to destroy incoming projectiles or strikecrafts before hand.

details.text: The galaxy has the flag acot_weapons_forbidden

technologies.name: Perplex Armor
technologies.description: In our attempts to explore the application of Dark Matter on its own as a resource catalyst without synthesis with that of Dark Energy, we have come to learn that the strange substance have peculiar interaction with Living Metal. Normally, a solidified Living Metal will attempt to regenerate and restore itself to that state. When coated with Dark Matter, the attempt seems to alter drastically, however. Instead, the substance attempts to do its best to regenerate and protect anything that is under it, even if it meant total breakdown of its own composition. With this in mind, we may develop a new type of armor that combines the properties of powerful exterior and exceptional interior regeneration.
